g.text: Evaluate the judge—and the answer-selection policy
A passing attempt, a selected acceptable answer and first-attempt success describe different behavior.

g.text: A success exists among three attempts.
Who identifies the usable second answer?
This is not an empirical pass@3 estimate.
Inspect severe false passes beyond average agreement.
Stricter grading can increase false failures. Upstart’s
judge-calibration story is program context; automated
Test and price the deployed selection policy
pass@k asks if at least one of k candidates passes.
State workload, test, k and first-attempt behavior;
evaluate the actual selector under that budget.
Count retries, tools, verification, latency and review.
Sources: Ramp/banking accounts, Upstart agenda and Chen et al. (2021). No company or finance benchmark score is claimed.
